display.purpose: Hero headlines. One per page. The phrase that receives gradient text is always Display size.

headline.purpose: Section H2 titles. Never more than two lines.

title.purpose: Card headings, feature names, H3 elements.

body.purpose: All descriptive copy. Always Muted Slate (#64748B) on dark backgrounds. Max 65ch.

label.purpose: Badges, stat labels, nav text, eyebrows. Uppercase + wide tracking signals metadata.

shadows.name: accent-glow
shadows.purpose: Interactive card hover state only. Never at rest.

shadows.name: hero-shadow
shadows.purpose: Device mockups and floating dashboard previews only.

motion.name: ease-out-quart

motion.name: stagger-child

motion.name: hover-scale
motion.purpose: Primary buttons on hover. Never more than 1.02.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main CTA. Always paired with a ghost button for secondary action.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: #2563EB; color: #ffffff; font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 600; padding: 14px 28px; border-radius: 12px; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background 200ms ease, transform 200ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #3B82F6; transform: scale(1.02); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2563EB; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action. Always appears alongside a primary button, never alone.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: transparent; color: #F8FAFC; font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 600; padding: 14px 28px; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.10); cursor: pointer; transition: background 200ms ease, border-color 200ms ease, transform 200ms ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.18); transform: scale(1.02); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2563EB; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Badge / Chip

narrative.overview:
DrLead's design language is built around a single image: a serious decision-maker in Riyadh or Dubai, glancing at a dashboard at 9am before their first client call. The interface should feel like it was made for that person — not a startup founder in San Francisco. Everything is dark, information-dense, and precise. No decoration earns its place unless it communicates something. Confidence comes from clarity, not from animation.

The system rejects three specific failure modes: generic SaaS cream, aggressive sales-funnel tactics, and corporate enterprise cold. The Gulf Control Room is none of those things. It is purposeful darkness — the kind you find in Bloomberg terminals and Stripe dashboards, not in crypto projects or AI-hype landing pages.

Color is restrained but committed. Two accent colors work as a gradient pair (blue → cyan) and almost never appear separately. The dark surface hierarchy does the structural work. Motion is orchestrated but never decorative.
keyCharacteristics: Two-color accent system (blue + cyan) used exclusively as a gradient pair
Tonal elevation — depth from layered surfaces, not shadows
Typography is the loudest design element
Gulf-aware through content and structure, never through decorative motifs

rules.name: The One Gradient Rule
rules.body: The blue→cyan gradient is the brand's single visual signature. It never appears as a background on large surfaces, never with a third color, and cyan is never used without blue.

rules.name: The Surface Staircase Rule
rules.body: Depth is expressed through four surfaces only: #0A0F1E → #0F172A → #1E293B → rgba(255,255,255,0.05). No other background values are permitted.

rules.name: The Tight Heading Rule
rules.body: Every heading gets letter-spacing: -0.02em. Loose-tracked headings at large sizes feel amateurish.

rules.name: The Muted Body Rule
rules.body: Body text on dark backgrounds is always #64748B, not white. Reserve Offwhite for headings and short UI labels only.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: All surfaces are flat at rest. Glow appears only on hover for interactive cards. Shadow appears only on device mockups.

dos: Do use the two-step dark background alternation (#0A0F1E ↔ #0F172A) to create visual rhythm between sections
Do use Muted Slate (#64748B) for all body text on dark backgrounds
Do apply letter-spacing: -0.02em to every heading at Title size and above
Do use the blue→cyan gradient exclusively as a pair
Do keep CTAs paired: one primary + one ghost. Never more than two primary buttons in the same visual group
Do cap body copy at 65ch per line
Do maintain WCAG AA contrast ratios
donts: Don't use white or light-gray backgrounds as a default
Don't use border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored accent stripe on cards
Don't make the site look like generic SaaS cream
Don't use aggressive sales-funnel patterns: countdown timers, fake scarcity, more than two CTAs in the same visual group
Don't use corporate enterprise cold aesthetics — stock photography, navy + gold, IBM-circa-2010 stiffness
Don't add glassmorphism as a default card style — maximum two glass cards per page
Don't apply the gradient to body text, button labels, or any text shorter than a full headline phrase
Don't use more than four identical cards in a grid with the same icon + heading + text structure
Don't animate layout properties (width, height, margin, padding)
Don't add shadows to cards at rest
